items.title: [Google Play 差评] ★1 Unfortunately, if you were drawn here du
items.summary: Unfortunately, if you were drawn here due to YouTube videos praising the game and the dev, things have changed quite drastically. Gameplay has been changed in a way that is very unpopular with the community. Endgame has been changed and inflated hp values completely screwed both invested players and new players building towards those teams. Units getting "bug fixed" right after a re-run. Light, the producer has been caught lying and backpedaling repeatedly about these changes. Memento Mori.
